Robot.Title: AIMeE Бот
Robot.Description: Designed by - presumably drunk - Norsec roboticists, AIMeE (or Automated Independent Mechanical Entity) can be a Stationeer's best friend, or tiresome nemesis, or both several times in the same day. Intended to unearth and retrieve ores automatically, the unit requires basic programming knowledge to operate, and Материнская плата (Программатор IC). AIMEe has 7 modes: RobotMode.None = 0 = Do nothing RobotMode.None = 1 = Follow nearest player RobotMode.None = 2 = Move to target in straight line RobotMode.None = 3 = Wander around looking for ores in 15 co-ords radius RobotMode.None = 4 = Unload in chute input or chute bin within 3 meters / 1.5 large grids RobotMode.None = 5 = Path(find) to target RobotMode.None = 6 = Automatic assigned state, shows when storage slots are fullПодключается к Логический передатчик

Agrizero.Title: Agrizero
Agrizero.Description: Agrizero is an agricultural biotech firm focused on researching and deploying offworld farming technology. The company’s aim is to provide a network of self-sustaining, self-contained 'bio-factories' that will ultimately feed a projected 1 million humans in space. Emerging from the late 21st century's environmental disasters, the firm has roots in China's world-saving artificial farming initiatives, and has now spread to facilities in the Asteroid Belt, where the supply of ice asteroids makes vertical farming and controlled-environment agriculture extremely promising. While many of their facilities are still under construction, Agrizero is already one of the main suppliers of offworld groups like ODA, Sinotai and ExMin through the ever-expanding Trader Network.

Asura.Title: Asura Biomedia
Asura.Description:
Asura Biomedia was founded in the early 22nd century by Mumbai-based trillionaire Ashan Gurwaja. Nominally focused on 'biotechnology', the company has always had an ‘elastic’ notion of exactly what that entailed: everything from pharmaceuticals to pet food.
        Gurwaja's background in bio-engineering firms put the company in the highest echelon of bio-science industries from the very beginning, and it grew exactly as its founder intended: rapidly and reliably, structured specifically to swallow up any smaller firms in its way.
        Near mid-century, Asura's ambitions evolved to embrace entire health systems – it is now the largest provider of healthcare on Earth, integrating hospitals and primary care with medical supplies, pharmaceutical production and retail, residential care and funeral services.
        By 2150, Asura's business was a simple proposition, as captured in their famous – if not infamous – advertising slogan: 'We're in you'.

CHAC.Title: CHAC
CHAC.Description: Founded in 2085 to produce weapons for Sinotai's space forces, the company is known for making highly reliable and affordable weapons for off-world use. Their pragmatic approach is reflected in their focus on designs suitable for 3D printing and mass production, as well as a high reuse of components across models and weapon classes. As a result, although CHAC guns excel in no particular category, and have certainly never been accused of greatness, they suffer no great failings, and perform sufficiently well by most known measures to have earned their designers the informal title of 'armorer to the Solar System'.

CableNetworkPage.Title: Cable Networks
CableNetworkPage.Description: When placing cables with Моток кабеля you create cable networks. These contain volatile memory that can be read or written to using a Микропроцессор IC10. This includes a variety of special logic variables such as Channel0 through to Channel7. The networks also have readable memory, which contains a list of all the data devices on the network, and can be used with GET to find the ReferenceId for that device. To find out the current quantity of devices in the stack, use the StackSize variable on the network, as the network adjusts its stack size dynamically based on devices within it. Cable Networks are volatile memory, and will change both their order, contents, and data whenever the network changes - so you may need to constantly poll and update the information. To access this, use extra notation on your device references such as d0:1 to access network 1 off the provided device. To find out the connection number, check the stationpedia page for that device for the number under the connections section.
CableNetworkPage.Text:
When placing cables with {THING:ItemCableCoil} you create cable networks. These contain volatile memory that can be read or written to using a  {THING:ItemIntegratedCircuit10}. This includes a variety of special logic variables such as {LOGICTYPE:Channel0} through to {LOGICTYPE:Channel7}. The networks also have readable memory, which contains a list of all the data devices on the network, and can be used with GET to find the {LOGICTYPE:ReferenceId} for that device. 
	  
To find out the current quantity of devices in the stack, use the {LOGICTYPE:StackSize} variable on the network, as the network adjusts its stack size dynamically based on devices within it. Cable Networks are volatile memory, and will change both their order, contents, and data whenever the network changes - so you may need to constantly poll and update the information.  

To access this, use extra notation on your device references such as {COLORYELLOW:d0}:{COLORYELLOW:1} to access network 1 off the provided device. To find out the connection number, check the stationpedia page for that device for the number under the connections section.

ExMin.Title: ExMin
ExMin.Description: После Cизифской катастрофы на Марсе в 2079 году, смещение астероидов было официально запрещено организацией ODA. Это кардинальное изменение вынудило зародившуюся космическую горнодобывающую промышленность пересмотреть свои стратегии, но до открытия космического лифта в Манаусе, маржинальная экономика означала, что добыча ресурсов за пределами земли была практически невозможной. Созданная в 2095 году давним швейцарско-немецким горнодобывающим конгломератом и консорциумом других интересов, ExMin на несколько десятилетий была больше идеей, чем коммерческой реальностью. Созданная с уверенностью, что космический лифт в конечном итоге появится, ExMin была одной из первых компаний, которая воспользовалась полученным доступом. Впоследствии она стала одной из самых сильных коммерческих предприятий Солнечной системы. Имея безопасный доступ к пространству, ExMin стала центральным игроком в потоке ресурсов во Внутреннюю систему. У нее есть конкуренция, в основном со стороны бразильского горнодобывающего гиганта Recurso, но компания никогда полностью не теряла лидерство в добыче полезных ископаемых за пределами земли. Синоним редкоземельных металлов и новаторских технологий, мировой добыче ресурсов стала ExMin, она стоит в авангарде развития всей Солнечной системы.

GeFabrik.Title: GeFabrik
GeFabrik.Description:
Officially known as Gewehrfabrik GmbH, GeFabrik is one of the world’s oldest and most highly regarded armament firms, known for producing exceptionally accurate, high-end firearms.
        In the wake of the European arms manufacturing collapse in the 2030s, a group of unemployed armament staff formed GeFabrik. Dedicated to renewing original design principles, the company is legendary for extensive testing, sometimes lasting as long as 10 years, in order to produce ‘ganz’ weapon formats.
        GeFabrik is widely regarded as having single-handedly salvaged Germany's manufacturing reputation, while doing nothing for their sense of humor.

Hiiragi.Description:
Founded by Noboru Hiiragi in the aftermath of the 2110s economic bubble, Hiiragi Communications absorbed several prominent offworld assets, quickly becoming the most widely used trans-Solar System communications network.

Hiiragi is also the number one seller for PCD’s (Personal Communication Devices) as well as a deep, if difficult to assess investor in terrestrial telecommunication networks.

LogicTypeColor.Description: Whether driven by concerns for clarity, safety or simple aesthetics, Stationeers have access to a small rainbow of colors for their constructions. These are the color setting for devices, represented as an integer. 0: Blue 1: Grey 2: Green 3: Orange 4: Red 5: Yellow 6: White 7: Black 8: Brown 9: Khaki 10: Pink 11: Purple It is an unwavering universal law that anything higher than 11 will be purple. Norsec.Title: Norsec
Norsec.Description: With its roots in early 20th Century defense industry, Norsec (a.k.a. Northern Security Systems) was an early adopter of asteroid mining – one of its tugs being involved in the infamous Sisyphus Hit on the fledgling Martian colony at Sanders. Norsec was officially cleared of any wrong-doing, but when the ODA banned asteroidal relocation, the company shifted its focus to infrastructure and manufacturing. Norsec’s orbitally-based Space Systems Division is responsible for the design and production of ODA’s core transport systems, while also being rumoured to hold a large interest in ExMin. The company is also noted for its willingness to engage in experimental robotic technology.

ODA.Title: ODA
ODA.Description: После Земного кризиса, внимание человечества к космосу уменьшилось. Однако многие считали, что без амбиций за пределами родной планеты, наш вид может идти неуверенно. Созданное в 2070 году недавно обновленной Организацией Объединенных Наций - Агентство Внеземного Развития (АВР) имело конкретную цель - направлять и поощрять освоение космоса человеком. Она открыла программу Stationeer в 2095 году. Понимая, что финансирование будет затруднено, ODA задумала программу как медленно действующую и низкозатратную космическую инициативу. Тем временем некоторые высмеивали Stationeers как «космических изгоев по сниженным ценам». Успех программы показал мудрость и прагматизм Агентства ODA.

StructureLogicPidController.Title: PID Controller
StructureLogicPidController.Description: A PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) controller that provides a closed-loop feedback mechanism that can be used to automatically regulate a process variable (like temperature, speed, position, and similar) so that it tracks a desired setpoint. It does this by continually computing an error signal e(t) = setpoint – measurement, then applying three corrective actions as the Proportional, Integral, and Derivative.

Recurso.Title: Recurso Espaciais
Recurso.Description: This long-standing Brazilian mining group branched into space in the late 21st century. Focused primarily on bulk minerals and metals, the company is perhaps best understood as an extension of the Brazilian government – very few upper echelon political figures in modern Brazil are not implicated in one arm or another of this industrial behemoth. Enmeshment with South American politics has given the company heavy influence over the Manaus space elevator. This deep state control has led to other groups – the ODA included – to exercise a certain ‘flexibility’ toward Recurso. Accusations of illegal asteroid relocation, safety violations and numerous commercial infringements have barely touched it. Meanwhile, defenders point out that very little has been proven in court, and Recurso is hardly alone – hence the truism: 'In space, we all live in glass houses.'

Rover_MkI.Title: Rover MkI
Rover_MkI.Description: A distant cousin of the jeep, the Mk I {Sinotai electric rover is one of the most simple and durable light vehicles in the known universe. Able to carry two passengers and cargo such as the Газовый резервуар (Воздух) or , it is powered by up to three batteries, accepting everything including Аккумулятор (Ядерный). A quad-array of hub-mounted electric engines propels the reinforced aluminium frame over most terrain and modest obstacles. While the Mk I is designed for stability in low-horizontality circumstances, if it rolls, try using your Лом to put it right way up.Подключается к Логический передатчик

Sinotai.Title: Sinotai
Sinotai.Description: The sole 'traditional' state entity to survive offworld politics, Sinotai’s reach and power is second only to the ODA itself. In many ways a relic – a sub-agency of a staggeringly complicated Earth-bound corporate-bureaucracy – its structure has allowed Sinotai to achieve incredible things. Proving its mettle in the early 21st Century by putting the first humans on Mars, establishing the first offworld gigawatt power system, and the first space-borne fuel refinery, few space-going organisations lack some degree of relationship with Sinotai. A common joke has it that it's impossible to do anything in space without them. Regardless of the truth, Sinotai's approach to off-world development has involved a 'soft power' approach, from MOU's with Recurso (giving them preferential access to the Manaus space elevator) to murkier alliances of convenience with a range of Trader groups.

TK.Title: TK Systems
TK.Description: Компания Tanzanian Kinetic Systems, изначально занимавшаяся оборонными контрактами с фокусом на грубой силе и высокомощном оружии, осуществила масштабную реструктуризацию в мирное время, чтобы стать ведущим разработчиком высокоскоростных конвейеров Африканской Ассамблеи. В настоящее время компания TK производит ряд конструкций и компонентов для сетей конвейерных труб и имеет сильное присутствие за пределами мира в результате афро-китайского партнерства во второй половине 21 века. Компания, расположенная в ‘восстановленном‘ районе Кигамбони в Дар-э-Саламе, регулярно вступает в партнерские отношения с CHAC и в результате многие из их продуктов демонстрируют заметное сходство. В конце концов, что такое пушка, как не ‘высокоскоростной грузовой конвейер’.

StructureAutolathe.Description: The foundation of most Stationeer fabrication systems, the ExMin autolathe is a multi-axis molecular compositional system. Its complexity demands considerable time to assemble, but it remains an indispensable creation tool. Upgrade the device using a Улучшение (Автолат) for additional recipes and faster processing speeds.

GasNitrogen.Title: Азот
GasNitrogen.Description: Азот can be mixed with Кислород to stabilize its flammability and avoid Кислород toxicity, and is a resource in its own right, useful for creating, a breathable atmosphere (at roughly 3:1 Азот and Кислород). The most efficient source of Азот is from Лёд (Нитрис) deposites found around the Solar System. You can Condense Азот into Жидкий азот by lowering its temperature below its boiling point.

ItemBatteryCell.Description: Harnessing a design pioneered in the early 21st century, the small battery cell is the Stationeer's basic unit of portable electrical power. While it lacks the charge of a Аккумулятор (Высокоёмкий) or Аккумулятор (Ядерный), it has the humble advantage of being fabricated from basic resources. POWER OUTPUT The small cell stores up to 36000 watts of power.

The vent has two modes: 'Outward' sets it to pump gas into a space until pressure is reached; 'Inward' sets it to pump gas out until pressure is reached. The pressure parameter can be set on a connected Консоль. Default pressure is 101kPa for Outward; 0kPa for Inward...

AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer.Title: Анализатор генов растений
AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer.Description: The Genetic Analyzer can be used to process samples from the Пробоотборник растений. Once processed, the genetic information of the sampled plant can be viewed by clicking on the search button. Individual Gene Value Widgets: Most gene values will appear as a sliding bar between a minimum value on the left and a maximum value on the right. The actual value of the gene is in the middle of the bar, in orange. Multiple Gene Value Widgets: For temperature and pressure ranges, four genes appear on the same widget. The orange values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for growth. Outside of this range, the plant will stop growing and eventually die. The blue values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for ideal growth. Inside of this range, the plant will grow at maximum speed. The white values above the bar are the minimum and maximum achievable values for the growth threshold.

StructureHorizontalAutoMiner.Title: ВЭГО
StructureHorizontalAutoMiner.Description: The Recurso ВЭГО (Вращающийся Экскаватор Грунтовый Ортогональный) is a base structure with attached mining vehicle, which will mine a horizontal shaft up to X meters long. When full, the mining vehicle will return to the base to empty itself, before returning to dig. If it encounters empty space, it will also return to base and await instruction. The unit will return if deactivated. The ВЭГО can be connected to a chute system, and is controllable by a logic network. Note that the OGRE outputs more ore than a conventional Шахтёрский бур over the same area, due to more efficient processing. MODES Idle - 0 Mining - 1 Returning - 2 DepostingOre - 3 Finished - 4

StructureWindTurbine.Description:
The Stationeers wind turbine was first designed by Norsec atmospheric engineers, looking to create a wind-driven power generation system that would operate even on exceedingly low atmosphere worlds. The ultra-light blades respond to exceedingly low atmospheric densities, while being strong enough to function even under huge strain in much more demanding environments.
        While the wind turbine is optimized to produce power (up to 500W) even on low atmosphere worlds, it performs best in denser environments. Output varies with wind speed and, during storms, may increase dramatically (up to 10,000W), so be careful to design your power networks with that in mind.

StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Title: Газотопливная центрифуга
StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Description: The Combustion Centrifuge is a gas powered version of the Центрифуга. If a Утилизатор or unbalanced Печь outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore. It also refines Руда (Необработанная) produced from the Глубинный рудокоп and Руда (Космическая) produced from the Ракетный бур. A combustible fuel mix should be supplied to the gas input, and waste gasses should be vented from the output. The machine's RPMs must be controlled via the throttle and combustion limiter levers. If the Combustion Centrifuge gains, or loses, RPMs too fast it will experience stress, and eventually grind to a halt. Higher RPMs directly result in faster processing speeds. The throttle lever controls the amount of fuel being pulled into the machine, increasing the temperature inside the engine, and leading to an increase in RPM. The limiter lever influences the speed of the combustion, and how much uncombusted gas is in the exhaust. Ejecting ore from the Combustion Centrifuge while it is at high RPMs will result in additional stress build up. If turned off while not stressed, the machine will automatically start to brake, and reduce RPMs in a controlled manner.

DeviceLfoVolume.Description: The low frequency oscillator (or LFO) makes everything sound dark, twisted and crunchy by altering the shape of the waves output by a Логический пошаговый секвенсор. To set up an LFO: 1. Place the LFO unit 2. Set the LFO output to a Пассивные колонки 2. Set a sequencers' output to LFO - so the sequencer's signal runs through the LFO to a speaker. 3. Place a Секундомер or use an existing one, then use a Чип (Запись) to write it to the LFO. 4. Use another logic writer to write the BPM to the LFO. 5. You are ready. This is the future. You're in space. Make it sound cool. For more info, check out the music page.

ItemGrenade.Title: Граната
ItemGrenade.Description: Invented by the Romans, who threw Greek Fire at their enemies in ceramic jars, the word 'grenade' is derived from the Old French word for 'pomegranate', as many modern grenades resemble this round, many-seeded fruit. Also like many grenades before it, this one goes boom and breaks stuff.

ItemMushroom.Title: Гриб
ItemMushroom.Description: A tasty food item. Unlike normal plants, it consumes Кислород and outputs Углекислый газ. Mushrooms will only mature at a moderate rate in darkness, and prolonged light will kill it.

StructureKlaxon.Title: Громкоговоритель
StructureKlaxon.Description: Klaxons allow you to play over 50 announcements and sounds, depending on your Logic set-up. Set the mode to select the output.

GasPollutedWater.Title: Грязная вода
GasPollutedWater.Description: Polluted water is a waste product from the use of Вода in certain devices. It will freeze into Чистый лёд (Грязная вода) but boil into Пар. A Очиститель воды can be used to convert it back to Вода.

ItemFilterFern.Title: Дарга-папоротник
ItemFilterFern.Description: A fern adapted by Agrizeroto process a much greater volume of Углекислый газ into Кислород than an average plant.

StructureMotionSensor.Title: Датчик движения
StructureMotionSensor.Description: Originally developed to monitor dance marathons, the motion sensor can also be connected to Logic systems for security purposes, automatic lighting, doors and various other applications. The sensor activates whenever a player enters the grid it is placed on.

StructureDaylightSensor.Title: Датчик дневного света
StructureDaylightSensor.Description: Daylight sensors provide data on whether the current region of your base is in sunlight, and report the exact solar angle. Note that the orientation of the sensor alters the reported solar angle, while Logic systems can be used to offset it.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Датчики)

StructureProximitySensor.Title: Датчик приближения
StructureProximitySensor.Description: Will be triggered if there is a player in the range of the sensor (as defined by the setting dial). The quantity variable will show the number of players. You can configure the sensor to only detect players who hold the correct Access Card using a Картридж (Контроль доступа) in a Планшет.

StructureOccupancySensor.Title: Датчик присутствия
StructureOccupancySensor.Description: Will be triggered if there is a player in the same room as the sensor. The quantity variable will show the number of players. StructureStirlingEngine.Title: Двигатель Стирлинга
StructureStirlingEngine.Description: Harnessing an ancient thermal exploit, the Recurso 'Libra' Stirling Engine generates power via the expansion and contraction of a working gas to drive pistons operating an electrical generator. When high pressure hot gas is supplied into the input pipe, this gas will heat the hot side of the unit, then pass into the output pipe. The cooler side uses the room's ambient atmosphere, which must be kept at a lower temperature and pressure in order to create a differential. Add a working gas by inserting a Газовый баллон. The unit must be deactivated when adding or removing canisters, or the working gas may leak into the surrounding atmosphere. Gases with a low molecular mass make the most efficient working gases. Increasing the moles of working gas can result in a greater potential power output. However, overpressuring the unit may have... sub-optimal results.

StructureArcFurnace.Title: Дуговая печь
StructureArcFurnace.Description: The simplest smelting system available to the average Stationeer, Recurso's arc furnace was forged itself in the depths of the Solar System to help explorational geologists determine the purity of potential asteroidal mining targets. Co-opted by the ODA, it now provides Stationeers with a way to produce pure ingots of various resources. The smelting process also releases a range of by product gases, principally Азот, Углекислый газ, Летучие вещества and Кислород in differing ratios. These can be recaptured from the atmosphere by filtering, but also make the arc furnace a risk in closed environments. Unlike the more advanced Печь, the arc furnace cannot create alloys.

GasLiquidNitrogen.Title: Жидкий азот

StructureAreaPowerControl.Title: ИБП
StructureAreaPowerControl.Description:
An Area Power Control (APC) has three main functions:
        Its primary purpose is to regulate power flow, ensuring uninterrupted performance from devices and machinery, especially those with a fluctuating draw.
        APCs also create sub-networks, as no devices on the far side of an APC are visible on the main network.
        Lastly, an APC charges batteries, which can provide backup power to the sub-network in the case of an outage. Note that an APC requires a battery to stabilize power draw. It also has two variants, each allowing power to flow in one direction only.

StructureIceCrusher.Title: Измельчитель льда
StructureIceCrusher.Description: The Recurso KoolAuger converts various ices into their respective gases and liquids. A remarkably smart and compact sublimation-melting unit, it produces gas or liquid depending on the ice being processed. The upper outlet is gas, the lower for liquid, and while you can attach any pipe you like to either outlet, it will only function if the correct network is attached. It will also only pass gas or liquid into a network if it is powered and turned on. If the KoolAuger is full, it will not accept any further ice until the gas or liquid contents is drained. In this state, it will flash a yellow error state on the activation switch.

StructureEvaporationChamber.Title: Камера испарения
StructureEvaporationChamber.Description: A device for safely evaporating liquids into gasses. Liquids and Gasses will both exist safely inside the device. Lowering the pressure target of the in-built back pressure regulator using the setting wheel will change the boiling temperature of liquids inside. The secondary gas input on the left is a heat-exchanger input and allows for heat exchange between the secondary input pipe and the internal atmosphere of the Evaporation Chamber. Paired with Камера конденсации Stationeers can exploit the phase change properties of gases to build a DIY air conditioner.

StructureAirConditioner.Title: Кондиционер
StructureAirConditioner.Description: Built using the Набор (Атмосфера), the ExMin-designed air conditioner is used to raise or lower input gas temperature. The unit has three pipe connections: input, output, and waste. Gas fed into the input will be heated or cooled to reach the target temperature, while the opposite will happen to gas on the waste network. Multiple Efficiency Multipliers can effect the amount of energy the Air Conditioner uses, and these can be view on the unit's green Information Panel. As the temperature difference between input and waste increases, the Temperature Differential Efficiency Multiplier will decrease. If input or waste temperature is extremely hot or cold, the Operational Temperature Efficiency will decrease. If the input or waste pipe has approach low pressures, the Pressure Efficiency will decrease. Газовый конвекционный радиаторs may be useful in bringing extreme pipe temperatures back towards normal world temperatures. For more information on using the air conditioner, consult the temperature control Guides page.

Xigo.Title: Ксиго
Xigo.Description:
A 2150CE survey revealed the Xigo 'X' as one of the most recognized symbols in the world. Yet few participants could clearly describe the company's actual scope.
        Precisely where the company begins and ends has been the subject of endless theories, financial studies and lawsuits – originally a website for price comparisons, the conglomerate expanded to embrace data, then distribution and finally production.
        It was a seemingly indiscriminate expansion, focused not on one industry, but all of them – taking in so many fields that business analysts have largely rejected the idea of Xigo as a single entity. Rather, it is a conceptual grouping for a branch of human activity. And while such statistics are – by their very nature – difficult to confirm, recent estimates suggest Xigo employs over 1.5% of the entire human race.
        Suffice to say, it produces almost everything.

LogicStepSequencer8.Title: Логический пошаговый секвенсор
LogicStepSequencer8.Description: The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions. As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure. Central to this pastime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED 1: Connect 8 Шаговый блокs to your step sequencer via the data port on the left hand side. 2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdriver. 3: Select the output speaker (eg Пассивные колонки) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the right hand side of the sequencer. 4: Place a Секундомер and use a Чип (Чтение) and Чип (Запись) to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer. 5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Регулятор and a Чип (Запись) to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 6: Insert a sound cartridge of your choosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartridge slot. 7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive). 8: Get freaky with the Генератор низкой частоты. 9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.

ItemIce.Title: Лёд (Вода)
ItemIce.Description: Water ice can be found on most planets in the Solar System, though not all worlds visited by Stationeers possess this resource. Highly sensitive to temperature, ice will begin to melt as soon as it is mined, unless kept in the Пояс шахтёра. When melting, ice produces a mixture of Пар and Азот gas.

ItemVolatiles.Title: Лёд (Летучие вещества)
ItemVolatiles.Description: An extremely reactive ice with numerous hydrocarbons trapped inside. For simplicity's sake, these are often displayed as H2 by devices like the Картридж (Анализатор атмосферы). Летучие вещества combust in a 2:1 ratio with Кислород, creating Углекислый газ and pollutants. However when catalysed via devices such as the Сжигатель H2 in the presence of Кислород, they produce Пар and heat with a modicum of Углекислый газ and Токсин due to the autoignition of the volatiles in the chamber. Along with Кислород, volatiles gas is also the major component of fuel for such devices as the Газовая горелка.

ItemNitrice.Title: Лёд (Нитрис)
ItemNitrice.Description: Нитрис - это псевдоним, данный Азотному льду, and found on many planets and moons in the Solar System. Given the inert nature of the Азот it produces, the ice is useful when making breathable atmospheres with low flammability. Highly sensitive to temperature, nitrice will begin to melt as soon as it is mined, unless the temperature is below zero, or it is stored in the Пояс шахтёра, Mining Belt MK II or devices like the Измельчитель льда or Морозилка.

ItemOxite.Title: Лёд (Оксит)
ItemOxite.Description: Oxite ice is largely composed of frozen Кислород, and found on many planets in the Solar System. Highly valuable and sought after, not all planets a Stationeer visits will have some. Highly sensitive to temperature, oxite will begin to melt as soon as it is mined, unless the temperature is below zero, or it is stored in the Пояс шахтёра, Mining Belt MK II or devices like the Измельчитель льда or Морозилка. When melting, oxite produces a mixture of Кислород and Азот.

ApplianceMicrowave.Title: Микроволновка
ApplianceMicrowave.Description: While countless 'better' ways of cooking Food have been invented in the last few hundred years, few are as durable or easy to fabricate as the OK-Zoomer microwave. Licensed from Xigo, the plans are based on a classic model from the mid-21st century, giving it a charmingly retro feel. But don't worry, it oscillates Вода molecules more than adequately. Just bolt it to a Электрический стол using a Разводной ключ to power it, follow the recipe, and you're cooking.

ItemMilk.Description: Full disclosure, it's not actually 'milk', but an Agrizero-invented synthesis of 5ml Соевое масло and 5g Папоротник, delicately blended in the Химическая установка. Surprisingly filling, it can be used as an ingredient to cook other food in the Микроволновка or Автоматическая микроволновка. Think, Кекс.

HowToBuild.Description: 5 x Масло from Соевое масло 5 x Фенокситол from Папоротник

StructureFridgeSmall.Title: Морозилка
StructureFridgeSmall.Description: Essentially a heavily insulated box that allows users to pipe in any desired atmosphere, the Recurso Minibar fridge was a simple solution to the problem of food decay. It stores a small number of items, at any temperature you can muster. For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Морозилка)

StructureFridgeBig.Title: Морозилка (Большая)
StructureFridgeBig.Description: The Xigo Koolaid fridge is a self-cooling storage device with 15 slots that preserves food when powered and turned on. While many users have complained about the placement of the power switch, its place in the pantheon of off-world whiteware is unquestioned. With its own permanent internal atmosphere, the Koolaid fridge slows the decay of food by maintaining an optimal internal temperature. Its power usage varies on the external temperature against which it must balance its internal temperature. As such, it must shed heat to operate, so the Koolaid fridge DOES NOT work in a vacuum. Also, don't leave the door open, as it will equalize with the current world temperature. And maybe start to beep. For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Большая морозилка)

ItemCableCoil.Title: Моток кабеля
ItemCableCoil.Description: Bodily metaphors are tired and anthropocentric, but it was Frida Stuppen, the first ODA Administrator, who said, 'Let the cabling be as the nerve and the vessel, transmitting power and data alike through systems we forge among the stars.' Later commentators suggested that she was simply putting a romantic gloss on a piece of dubious economy. Whatever the case, standard cabling is where any Stationeer's network begins. Normal coil has a maximum wattage of 5kW. For higher-current applications, use Моток кабеля (Силовой).

ItemMiningDrillHeavy.Title: Мощный шахтёрский бур
ItemMiningDrillHeavy.Description: Sometimes mining trips require something a little bigger to bring home the goods. This scaled up version of the Recurso 'Topo' design Шахтёрский бур can literally move mountains. The heavy mining drill will remove more ground and mine ore more quickly than the standard mining drill. The heavy mining drill is also resilient to temperature and pressure. So no matter what planet or extreme weather conditions may be present, the Recurso heavy mining drill will get the job done.

StructureWallHeater.Description: The Xigo wall heater is a simple device that can be installed on a wall or frame and connected to power. When switched on, it will start heating the surrounding environment. It consumes 1010W of power and can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain level.

StructureWallCooler.Title: Настенный охладитель
StructureWallCooler.Description: The Xigo Freezy Boi wall cooler complements the wall heater, which can only raise the temperature. The wall cooler functions by drawing heat from the surrounding atmosphere and adding that heat into its pipe network. In order to run the wall cooler properly, you will need to connect pipes to the wall cooler and fill the connected pipe network with any type of gas. The gas's heat capacity and volume will determine how fast it reacts to temperature changes. EFFICIENCY The higher the difference in temperature between the gas stored in the pipes and the room, the less efficient the wall cooler will be. So to keep the wall cooler running at an acceptable efficiency you will need to get rid of the heat that accumulates in the pipes connected to it. A common practice would be to run the pipes to the outside and use radiators on the outside section of the pipes to get rid of the heat. The less efficient the wall cooler, the less power it consumes. It will consume 1010W at max efficiency. The wall cooler can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain degree. ERRORS If the wall cooler is flashing an error then it is missing one of the following: - Pipe connection to the wall cooler. - Gas in the connected pipes, or pressure is too low. - Atmosphere in the surrounding environment or pressure is too low. For more information about how to control temperatures, consult the temperature control Guides page.

StructureNitrolyzer.Title: Нитролизёр

More NOS will be created, if the gas inside the machine is close to a 1/1 ratio of Oxygen to Nitrogen. The second gas input line in optional, and not required if the gas is pre mixed.

ItemScrewdriver.Title: Отвёртка
ItemScrewdriver.Description: This standard issue frictional adherence adjustor is a top of the line, bi-rotational model with a columnated uni-grip. It's definitely not just a screwdriver. Use it for construction and deconstruction of certain kits, and setting values on logic units.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 2 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

StructureWaterPurifier.Title: Очиститель воды
StructureWaterPurifier.Description: Cleans Грязная вода and outputs Вода. The purification process requires Древесный уголь which can be added to the machine via the import bin. The procesing throughput can be improved by increasing the gas pressure of the input pipe relative to the gas pressure of the output pipe.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Очиститель воды)
2 x Набор (Жидкостная труба)
Отвёртка 2 x Моток кабеля

HowToBuild.Description: 250 x Energy 15 x Железо from Слиток (Железа) 10 x Кремний from Слиток (Кремний)

ItemFern.Title: Папоротник
ItemFern.Description: There was a time, when Stationeers had to make Фенокситол using the Процессор реагентов. Recent advances in technology allow you to use equivalent quantities of fern directly in recipes.

GasSteam.Title: Пар
GasSteam.Description: Evaporated Вода. It can be created by rasing the temperature of Вода to its boiling point. When introduced into a pipe Пар will condense back into Вода if it's temperature is below it's boiling point. Steam can be created by combusting Летучие вещества and oxygen using the Сжигатель H2

StructurePassiveVent.Title: Пассивная вентиляция
StructurePassiveVent.Description: Passive vents allow gases to move into and out of pipe networks, which are closed systems unless connected to a device or structure. Passive vents are not powered, merely an aperture, essentially turning an enclosed space into part of the pipe network.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Пассивная вентиляция)

StructurePassiveVentValve.Title: Пассивная вентиляция (Вентиль)
StructurePassiveVentValve.Description: Passive vents (Valve) allow gasses to move into and out of pipe networks, which are closed systems unless connected to a device or structure. Passive vents are not powered, but allow the user to choose when to allow gases in an enclosed space to mix inside a pipe network.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Пассивная вентиляция)
1 x Набор (Пассивная вентиляция: Изолированная)

StructureWallVent.Title: Пассивная вентиляция (Сквозная)
StructureWallVent.Description: Used to mix atmospheres passively between two walls.

StructurePassiveLiquidDrain.Description: Moves liquids from a pipe network to the world atmosphere.

StructureFloorDrain.Title: Пассивный водосток
StructureFloorDrain.Description:
A passive liquid floor inlet that quickly removes liquids in one direction from the world into the connected pipe network and equalises gasses with the world atmosphere.
        It will remove liquids from grids at the same level up to 6 Grids away.

StructurePowerTransmitter.Title: Передатчик микроволновой энергии
StructurePowerTransmitter.Description: The Norsec Wireless Power Transmitter is an uni-directional, A-to-B, far field microwave electrical transmission system.The rotatable base transmitter delivers a narrow, non-lethal microwave beam to a dedicated base receiver. The transmitter must be aligned to the base station in order to transmit any power. The brightness of the transmitter's collimator arc provides an indication of transmission intensity. Note that there is an attrition over longer ranges, so the unit requires more power over greater distances to deliver the same output.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Беспроводная передача энергии)

StructurePowerTransmitterOmni.Description: Когда включен и запитан, дистанционно заряжает Беспроводной аккумулятор и Беспроводной аккумулятор (Ёмкий).

DynamicScrubber.Title: Переносной воздушный фильтр
DynamicScrubber.Description: A portable scrubber does just what it sounds like: removes specific substances from the air. For instance, attaching a Фильтр (Углекислый газ) will pull Углекислый газ from the surrounding atmosphere. Note that the scrubber has room for one battery and two filters, which will double its operating speed. Neat. When it reaches an internal pressure of 8106kPA, an error signal will flash on the switch, indicating it needs to be emptied. Either vent it directly, or attach it to a pipe network via a Kit (Tank Connector) and a Разводной ключ.

DynamicGenerator.Title: Переносной генератор
DynamicGenerator.Description: Every Stationeer's best friend, the portable generator gets you up and running, fast. Fill it with a Газовый баллон (Топливо) to power up and charge a Аккумулятор (Обычный), or attach it to a Коннектор питания to link it into your electrical network. It's pressure driven, so functions more efficiently at lower temperatures, and REALLY efficiently if supercooled. Perfecting your fuel mix also makes a big difference.

PortableComposter.Title: Переносной компостер
PortableComposter.Description: A simple composting device, the basic composter creates Удобрение out of organic matter. It accepts food, Разложившаяся пища or Биомасса. It requires a full Жидкостный баллон and a battery to operate, accelerating the natural composting process. When processing, it releases nitrogen and volatiles, as well a small amount of heat. Compost composition Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. The fertilizer's effects on plants will vary depending on the respective proportions of its ingredients. - food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times - Разложившаяся пища increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times - Биомасса increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for

HowToBuild.Description: 20000 x Energy 15 x Медь from Слиток (Медь) 10 x Сталь from Слиток (Сталь)

DynamicAirConditioner.Title: Переносной кондиционер
DynamicAirConditioner.Description: The Sinotai-designed Huxi portable air conditioner cools by drawing heat from the atmosphere and storing it, or adding heat to the atmosphere from its internal tank. With a max internal pressure of 8106kPa, its capacity is relatively limited, physics being clear on this subject. To extend its temperature storage ability, bolt the Huxi to a Коннектор резервуара, then connect it to a pipe network supplying hot or cold gases.

DynamicLight.Title: Переносной светильник
DynamicLight.Description: Philippe Starck might not applaud, but this battery-powered light source undarkens the corners when illumination's lacking. Powered by any battery, it's a 'no-frills' Xigo design that can be cheaply fabricated with the minimum of fuss. Unless you like fuss. In which case, fuss all you like.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа) 2 x Медь from Слиток (Медь)

DynamicCrate.Title: Переносной ящик
DynamicCrate.Description: The humble dynamic crate has become a symbol of Stationeer invention and independence. With twelve slots and handles at either end for ease of carriage, it's both standard issue and critical kit for cadets and Commanders alike.

CrateMkII.Title: Переносной ящик (Улучшенный)
CrateMkII.Description: A more heavily reinforced version of the iconic Переносной ящик, the Crate Mk II is resistant to incredibly high pressures and temperatures. Short of disposing of it in a black hole, the Mk II is about as safe as luggage gets.

StructureFurnace.Title: Печь
StructureFurnace.Description: The Zhurong furnace employs a high-temperature gas mixture of Кислород and Летучие вещества to smelt ingots and a range of alloys as raw materials for fabricators. A basic gas mixture can be achieved by adding Лёд (Оксит) and Лёд (Летучие вещества) in a 1:2 ratio directly to the furnace, but more complex alloys will require careful management of a dedicated gas mixing network. Exact ingredient ratios must be observed. Likewise, smelting ores at insufficient temperatures will produce reagents, which must be recycled. If liquids are present in the furnace, they will gather there until the furnace is connected to a liquid pipe network.

Rover_MkI_build_states.Title: Планетоход
Rover_MkI_build_states.Description: A distant cousin of the jeep, the Mk I {Sinotai electric rover is one of the most simple and durable light vehicles in the known universe. Able to carry two passengers and cargo such as the Газовый резервуар (Воздух) or , it is powered by up to three batteries, accepting everything including Аккумулятор (Ядерный). A quad-array of hub-mounted electric engines propels the reinforced aluminium frame over most terrain and modest obstacles. While the Mk I is designed for stability in low-horizontality circumstances, if it rolls, try using your Лом to put it right way up.

A dynamic multi-tool that accepts a range of cartridges, the Padi becomes an Картридж (Анализатор атмосферы) or Картридж (Навигатор), Картридж (Медицинский анализатор), Картридж (Георадар), Картридж (Справочник), and various other functions.

CircuitboardAirControl.Title: Плата (Управление атмосферой)
CircuitboardAirControl.Description: When added to a Консоль, air control circuit boards allow you to program an Активная вентиляция. As with small dogs and 83% of people, air control circuits have only three modes: Pressure, Draft and Offline. Pressure mode maintains a 100kPa atmosphere, switching the active vent between inward and outward flow until target pressure is achieved. Draft mode allows you to pair active vents to circulate air. Offline mode deactivates the vent.

CircuitboardDoorControl.Title: Плата (Управление дверями)
CircuitboardDoorControl.Description: A basic tool of Stationeer base construction, this circuit board provides a way to open and close a Композитная дверь, Усиленная дверь or Стеклянная дверь remotely, when connected to a Консоль. This system can be further linked to Датчик движения to create automatic doors.

CircuitboardPowerControl.Title: Плата (Управление питанием)
CircuitboardPowerControl.Description: Under distant suns and demanding environments, Stationeer systems need to balance reliability, resilience and versatility. The power control board allows remote enabling and disabling of selected devices, disconnecting manual operation. The circuit board has two modes: 'Link' switches all devices on or off; 'Toggle' switches each device to their alternate state.

CircuitboardSolarControl.Title: Плата (Управление солнечными панелями)

CircuitboardAirlockControl.Title: Плата (Управление шлюзом)
CircuitboardAirlockControl.Description: Rumored to have been first sketched on a Norsec toilet wall by a disgruntled engineer, the Exgress airlock control circuit board’s versatility and ease of fabrication has made it the Stationeers control system of choice for Дверь шлюза cycling protocols. To enter setup mode, insert the board into a Консоль along with a data disk. In this mode, you can see all data-accessible objects currently connected to the Консоль. Doors, lights, gas sensors and slave consoles can be selected (highlighted green), and will be controlled once the data disk is removed.

StructureSecurityPrinter.Description: Any Stationeer concerned about security needs the Harkwell-designed Vigilant-E security printer. Use the Vigilant-E to create a Картридж (Контроль доступа), in order to restrict access to different parts of your base via keycards like the Карта доступа (Голубая). StructurePowerTransmitterReceiver.Title: Приёмник микроволновой энергии
StructurePowerTransmitterReceiver.Description: The Norsec Wireless Power Transmitter is an uni-directional, A-to-B, far field microwave electrical transmission system.The rotatable base transmitter delivers a narrow, non-lethal microwave beam to a dedicated base receiver. The transmitter must be aligned to the base station in order to transmit any power. The brightness of the transmitter's collimator arc provides an indication of transmission intensity. Note that there is an attrition over longer ranges, so the unit requires more power over greater distances to deliver the same output.Подключается к Логический передатчик

GeneDarkPerDay.Description: Время, необходимое растению для сна. В течение этого промежутка на растение не должен падать солнечный свет или свет от фитолампы, чтобы оно могло отдохнуть. Для этого, в среднем, растениям достаточно 5-и минут.

AppliancePackagingMachine.Title: Простая упаковочная машина
AppliancePackagingMachine.Description: The Xigo Cannifier requires Пустая банка and cooked food to create long-lasting, easily stored sustenance. Note that the Cannifier must be bolted to a Электрический стол for power, and only accepts cooked food and tin cans. OPERATION 1. Add the correct ingredients to the device via the hopper in the TOP. 2. Close the device using the dropdown handle. 3. Activate the device. 4. Remove canned goods from the outlet in the FRONT. Note: the Cannifier will flash an error on its activation switch if you attempt to activate it before closing it.

ItemJetpackBasic.Title: Простой реактивный ранец
ItemJetpackBasic.Description: The basic CHAC jetpack isn't 'technically' a jetpack, it's a gas thruster. It can be powered by any gas, so long as the internal pressure of the canister is higher than the ambient external pressure. If the external pressure is greater, the spacepack will not function. Indispensable for building, mining and general movement, it has ten storage slots and lets Stationeers fly at 3m/s, compared to the more powerful Прочный реактивный ранец. Adjusting the thrust value alters your rate of acceleration, while activating the stabilizer causes the spacepack to hover when a given height is reached. USE: 'J' to activate; 'space' to fly up; 'left ctrl' to descend; and 'WASD' to move.

ItemHardJetpack.Description: The Norsec jetpack isn't 'technically' a jetpack at all, it's a gas thruster. It can be powered by any gas, so long as the internal pressure of the canister is higher than the ambient external pressure. If the external pressure is greater, the spacepack will not function. Adjusting the thrust value alters your rate of acceleration, while activating the stablizer causes the spacepack to hover when a given height is reached. The hardsuit jetpack is capable of much higher speeds than the Простой реактивный ранец - up to 15m/s. Indispensable for building, mining and general movement, it has fourteen storage slots. DecayedFood.Title: Разложившаяся пища
DecayedFood.Description: When your food decays, it turns into this. ODA scientists have attempted to determine the exact constituents of this substance, but it remains evasive and mysterious. Suffice to say, eating it is a bad idea. Research has determined, however, that The exact speed of decay varies individually by: - TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C). - FOOD TYPE - Each food type has its own decay properties. Консервы (Суп из помидоров) lasts a lot longer than a Помидор, for instance. - PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. - ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods: > Кислород x 1.3 > Азот x 0.6 > Углекислый газ x 0.8 > Летучие вещества x 1 > Токсин x 3 > Закись азота x 1.5 > Пар x 2 > Vacuum (see PRESSURE above)

StructureRocketCelestialTracker.Title: Ракетный небесный трекер
StructureRocketCelestialTracker.Description: The Celestial Tracker can be placed in Rockets and when turned on will provide data that can be used to orientate devices such as the Телескоп. The Horizontal and Vertical output is localized to the orientation of the tracker. You can calibrate your alignment by comparing the result for the primary body with the output from the Датчик дневного света. Full functionality will only be available in orbit, but you can configure using the primary body. For aligning with the telescope, have the face plate facing up and the cables facing in the same direction as for the telescope and the output values will be aligned.

ItemRice.Title: Рис
ItemRice.Description: Rice grows at a moderate rate as long as its supplied with plenty of water.  Being more dependant on water, rice plants can easily die during periods of drought.

ItemIronOre.Title: Руда (Железо)
ItemIronOre.Description: Abundant throughout the Solar System, iron is the ore most commonly used by Stationeers constructing offworld bases. It can be smelted into both Слиток (Железа)s and Слиток (Сталь)s.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Железо

ItemGoldOre.Title: Руда (Золото)
ItemGoldOre.Description: Surprisingly common throughout the Solar System, Gold is thought to originate in the heart of supernovas, gathering as dust in the early stages of solar formation, then incorporating into the slowly accreting planetary bodies. Now a prized element in Stationeer construction, Gold is valued not for its beauty, but its reliability: inert, durable, conductive and highly stable, gold's strength is that it does nothing.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Золото

ItemCobaltOre.Title: Руда (Кобальт)
ItemCobaltOre.Description: Cobalt is a chemical element with the symbol "Co" and is typically found in only small deposits. Cobalt is a rare substance, but used create the Heal Pill and several alloys.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Кобальт

ItemSpaceOre.Title: Руда (Космическая)
ItemSpaceOre.Description: Ore mined from asteroids via the Ракетный бур which then must be processed in the Центрифуга, or Газотопливная центрифуга to produce smeltable ores.

ItemSiliconOre.Title: Руда (Кремний)
ItemSiliconOre.Description: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol "Si" and is one of the most useful elements to Stationeers. Readily available throughout the universe, silicon is used in a range of alloys, glass, plastics and various electronic components a Stationeer may need to complete their mission.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Кремний

ItemCopperOre.Title: Руда (Медь)
ItemCopperOre.Description: Copper is a chemical element with the symbol "Cu". This common and highly conductive material is found on most astronomical bodies and is used in a variety of manufacturing processes including electronic components, alloys, and wires.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Медь

ItemDirtyOre.Title: Руда (Необработанная)
ItemDirtyOre.Description: Ore mined from bedrock via the Глубинный рудокоп which then can be used in the Центрифуга, or Газотопливная центрифуга. Once processed, it produces ore in a ratio similar to the average found on the planet's surface.

ItemNickelOre.Title: Руда (Никель)
ItemNickelOre.Description: Nickel is a chemical element with the symbol "Ni" and is a rare metal commonly used as a plating to prevent corrosion. Sought after by many Stationeers, Nickel is also commonly used to create several alloys.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Никель
1 x Свинец

ItemSilverOre.Title: Руда (Серебро)
ItemSilverOre.Description: Silver is a chemical element with the symbol "Ag". Valued by many Stationeers for its attractive luster and sheen, it is also used in a variety of electronics components and alloys.

HowToBuild.Description: 1 x Серебро

ItemCoalOre.Title: Руда (Уголь)
ItemCoalOre.Description: Humanity wouldn't have got to space without humble, combustible coal. Burn it in a Генератор (Твердотопливный), smelt it in the Печь to create alloys, or use it in the Процессор реагентов to make Баллончик с краской (Чёрный).

ItemUraniumOre.Title: Руда (Уран)
ItemUraniumOre.Description: In 1934, Enrico Fermi noticed that bombarding uranium with neutrons produced a burst of beta rays, and a new material. This process was named 'nuclear fission', and resulted in cheap energy, the Cold War, and countless thousand deaths. While reasonably common throughout the Solar System, Stationeers are wary of the material.

H2Combustor.Title: Сжигатель H2
H2Combustor.Description: Adapted slightly from its original Recurso design, the Летучие вещества Combustor does exactly what its name suggests - it burns a mixture of volatiles and Кислород to create water. Extremely useful in hot or arid environments, users need to be aware that the combustor outputs considerable waste heat. The device is also less than perfectly efficient, resulting in the autoignition of volatiles in the chamber, and the production of waste gases which must be dealt with.

ItemReagentMix.Title: Смесь реагентов
ItemReagentMix.Description: Reagent mix is pure potential. A slurry of undifferentiated ores, it is output by the Утилизатор and can be fed into the Центрифуга to separate and recover the individual materials. Reagent mix is also output by the Печь when the current contents are ejected without smelting a specific ingot.

AppliancePlantGeneticSplicer.Title: Соединитель генов растений
AppliancePlantGeneticSplicer.Description: The Genetic Splicer can be used to copy a single gene from one 'source' plant to another 'target' plant of the same type. After copying, the source plant will be destroyed. To begin splicing, place a plant or seed bag in the left slot (source) and place another plant or seed bag of the same type in the right slot (target). You can select a gene using the arrow buttons. Close the sliding door and press the green activate button. Once splicing has begun, the device will be locked until the process has finished (which will take approximately twenty minutes). If you want to cancel splicing you can power off the bench or detach the appliance as a last resort.

StructureSorter.Title: Сортировщик
StructureSorter.Description: No amount of automation is complete without some way of moving different items to different parts of a system. The Xigo A2B sorter can be programmed via a computer with a Материнская плата (Сортировщик) to direct various items into different chute networks. Filtered items are always passed out the righthand side of the sorter, while non filtered items continue straight through.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Набор (Сортировщик)

StructureLogicSorter.Title: Сортировщик (Логический)
StructureLogicSorter.Description: Contains an Internal Memory which is assessed to check whether something should be sorted. When an item is in the Импорт Slot, the stack is checked and if result is true the thing is moved to the Export 2 slot, otherwise it is moved to the Экспорт slot. The Mode is used in how the stack is assessed, by default the mode is ALL, so every instruction in the stack would need to return true.

Stationeers.Title: Станционеры
Stationeers.Description: In the early 22nd century, Earth was emerging from a cataclysm. Its resources eroded, our population reduced, rebuilding was the spirit of the era. Initiated by the Offworld Development Agency (ODA) in 2095CE, the Stationeers Program was dedicated to a single ideal: keeping humanity pointed at the stars. Stationeers are everything: astronauts, engineers and explorers, deployed with limited equipment and tools, trained to do more with less. Turning the environment to their advantage, their job is to provide infrastructure for humans in space, at a fraction of the cost of traditional space programs. Able to build and maintain bases anywhere from the Moon to Mimas and beyond, Stationeers are our vanguard in the cosmos. Schooled in offworld survival, mining and construction techniques, basic metallurgy, electronics, rocketry, hydroponics and more ‘arcane’ sciences, Stationeers do what they must to survive, and thrive. Renowned for having no entry criteria, there is no such thing as a ‘typical’ Stationeer. Psychological profiling suggests successful Cadets show a ‘baseline’ pragmatism and single-mindedness, but some of the most famous Stationeers possess neither of these qualities. Recruiting from civil engineering backgrounds, military and aerospace industries, software development, mining groups, as well as scientific fields and even religious orders, the Stationeers Program is – fundamentally – open to all humanity.

StructureBattery.Title: Станционная батарея
StructureBattery.Description: Providing large-scale, reliable power storage, the Sinotai 'Dianzi' station battery is the heart of most Stationeer bases. There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.' POWER OUTPUT Able to store up to 3600000W of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Моток кабеля (Силовой). Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an ИБП and Трансформатор (Большой).

There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.' POWER OUTPUT Able to store up to 9000001 watts of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Моток кабеля (Силовой). StructureRoboticArmDock.Title: Станция Ларри

It can also grab items from a Транспортная труба (Экспорт) and drop them in a Транспортная труба (Импорт). LArRE can interact with plant trays or chute bins built under a linear rail station or built under its dock.

StructureLarreDockAtmos.Title: Станция Ларри (Атмосферная)
StructureLarreDockAtmos.Description: The atmospherics LArRE can pump gas into and out of its storage canister. When lowered over a Пассивная вентиляция, the atmospherics LArRE will connect with it and pump gas into and out of the connected pipe network. Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by. The base atmospheric logic values point to LArRE's internal gas storage. The Input atmospheric logic values point to the grid that LArRE is in OR the pipe network that LArRE is docked to via a Пассивная вентиляция

StructureLarreDockHydroponics.Title: Станция Ларри (Гидропонная)
StructureLarreDockHydroponics.Description:
The hydroponics LArRE can plant and harvest plants as well as place fertiliser into plant trays. It has an additional hopper slot which will feed items into the 'hand' slot when the hand slot is empty. Harvesting a different plant while the hand slot is full will be possible if the hopper slot is empty. In which case the plant in the hand will be moved into the hopper slot and the new plant will be harvested into the hand slot.
        The slot variables of a plant in the plant tray below can be read using the Proxy Slot Index (255).
        Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.

It requires Вода and power to operate, accelerating the natural composting process. When processing, it releases nitrogen and volatiles, as well a small amount of heat. Compost composition Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. The fertilizer's effects on plants will vary depending on the respective proportions of its ingredients. - Food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times - Разложившаяся пища increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times - Биомасса increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for up to five times

With a Микропроцессор IC10 in the IC чип, you can access variable slots on the carrying human using the device numbers (d0, d1, etc...), so long as the item can be access via logic, such as the Прочный скафандр.Подключается к Логический передатчик

StructureBlastDoor.Title: Усиленная дверь
StructureBlastDoor.Description: Airtight and almost undamageable, the original 'Millmar' series of blast door was designed by off-world mining giant Recurso to protect asteroid-mining facilities from nuclear-incident-level explosive decompression. Short of a pocket-sized singularity blinking into the local space-time frame, there is effectively no limit to the pressure these blast doors can contain - ideal for constructing airlocks in pressure-sensitive environments.

GeneHighTemperatureResistance.Title: Устойчивость к высокой температуре
GeneHighTemperatureResistance.Description: Максимальная температура. Её дальнейшее повышение, приведёт к гибели растения спустя определённый промежуток времени (ген Терпимость к высокой температуре).

GeneHighPressureResistance.Title: Устойчивость к высокому давлению
GeneHighPressureResistance.Description: Максимальное давление, превышение которого приведёт к гибели растения спустя определённый промежуток времени (ген Терпимость к высокому давлению).

GeneLowTemperatureResistance.Title: Устойчивость к низкой температуре
GeneLowTemperatureResistance.Description: Минимальная температура. Её дальнейшее снижение, приведёт к гибели растения спустя определённый промежуток времени (ген Терпимость к низкой температуре).

GeneLowPressureResistance.Title: Устойчивость к низкому давлению
GeneLowPressureResistance.Description: Минимальное давление. Его дальнейшее снижение, приведёт к гибели растения спустя определённый промежуток времени (ген Терпимость к низкому давлению).

GeneUndesiredGasResistance.Title: Устойчивость к токсинам
GeneUndesiredGasResistance.Description: Превышение парциального давления токсичного газа выше допустимого приведет к гибели растения спустя определённый промежуток времени (ген Терпимость к токсинам).

DevicePage.Title: Устройства
DevicePage.Description: Устройства - это конструкции, которые обладают специальными функциями, такими как управление логикой, атмосферой, энергией и т.п. Сборка выполняется также, как и другие конструкции.

StructureRecycler.Title: Утилизатор
StructureRecycler.Description: A device for collecting the raw resources while destroying an item. Produces Смесь реагентов containing packages of reagents. Pass these through the Центрифуга to gain back the source ores. Plants and organic matter passed through will create Biomass, which when passed through the Центрифуга will produce Биомасса.

StructureToolManufactory.Description: No mission can be completed without the proper tools. The Norsec ThuulDek manufactory can fabricate almost any tool or hand-held device a Stationeer may need to complete their mission, as well as a variety of delightful paints. Upgrade the device using a Улучшение (Фабрика инструментов) for additional recipes and faster processing speeds.

ItemGasFilterNitrogen.Title: Фильтр (Азот)
ItemGasFilterNitrogen.Description: Filters are used to capture various gases, which can be disposed of or used elsewhere. Азот is a byproduct of smelting various ores, notably Лёд (Нитрис), which may be combined with Кислород to make a breathable - and considerably less flammable - atmosphere.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

ItemGasFilterWater.Title: Фильтр (Вода)
ItemGasFilterWater.Description: Sinotai filters are used to capture various gases, which can be disposed of, or used elsewhere. Вода can be collected by filtering smelted Лёд (Вода)

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)
500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

ItemGasFilterOxygen.Title: Фильтр (Кислород)
ItemGasFilterOxygen.Description: Sinotai have cornered the market in filter design. Their trademarked templates are simple to print and highly efficient at capturing various gases, which can be disposed of or used elsewhere. Кислород is a common byproduct of smelting various ores, but must be filtered of such impurities as Азот using this filter and various devices, such as the Набор (Переносной воздушный фильтр).

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

ItemGasFilterVolatiles.Title: Фильтр (Летучие вещества)
ItemGasFilterVolatiles.Description: Filters are used to capture various gases, which can be disposed of or used elsewhere. Летучие вещества are created by exposing Лёд (Летучие вещества) to heat. The product can then be collected and combined with Кислород to create fuel, or used within a Печь to smelt ores and create alloys.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

ItemGasFilterPollutants.Title: Фильтр (Токсин)
ItemGasFilterPollutants.Description: Filters are used to capture various gases, such as waste emissions from a Печь or Дуговая печь. Adding Sinotai-designed Токсин filters to a Набор (Переносной воздушный фильтр) allows you to isolate this gas, then add it to a pipe network and employ its excellent coolant properties in a Настенный охладитель. Try not to inhale.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

ItemGasFilterCarbonDioxide.Title: Фильтр (Углекислый газ)
ItemGasFilterCarbonDioxide.Description: Given humanity's obsession with exhaling Углекислый газ, all Stationeers are issued two basic Sinotai Углекислый газ Фильтр as part of their standard deployment kit (SDK). These filters allow passage of Углекислый газ into the suit's waste Газовый баллон, but are also critical components of the Переносной воздушный фильтр and the Воздушный фильтр. The Средний фильтр (Углекислый газ) and Большой фильтр (Углекислый газ) are also available.

HowToBuild.Description: 500 x Energy 5 x Железо from Слиток (Железа)

StructureRefrigeratedVendingMachine.Title: Холодильный склад
StructureRefrigeratedVendingMachine.Description: The refrigerated OmniKool vending machine is an advanced version of the standard Склад, which maintains an optimum pressure and constant temperature of -130 degrees C, to prevent food spoilage. It can hold up to 100 stacks. The OmniKool also has an in-built Стакер, allowing players to set the stack sizes of any items ADDED to the device. The unit's default stack size is 50. ItemPlantThermogenic_Genepool1.Title: Цветок Аида (Альфа-штамм)
ItemPlantThermogenic_Genepool1.Description: The Agrizero's-created Hades Flower is the result of as dubious experiment to combine the allure of tropical plants with the comfort and homeliness of a heat pump. The plant breathes a 1:3 mix of Летучие вещества and Кислород, and exhales heated Токсин.

ItemPlantThermogenic_Genepool2.Title: Цветок Аида (Бета-штамм)
ItemPlantThermogenic_Genepool2.Description: The Agrizero's-created Hades Flower is the result of as dubious experiment to combine the allure of tropical plants with the comfort and homeliness of a heat pump. The plant breathes a 1:3 mix of Летучие вещества and Кислород, and exhales heated Токсин. The beta strain is notably more efficient than the earlier, more experimental alpha variant.

ItemPlantEndothermic_Genepool1.Title: Цветок Зимы (Альфа-штамм)
ItemPlantEndothermic_Genepool1.Description: Agrizero's Winterspawn atmospheric bio-processor is a recent addition to their catalog of genespliced environmental decorations. Using ambient heat to split Вода into Летучие вещества and Кислород, the Winterspawn cools its surroundings, when supplied with sufficient Азот. The alpha variant has a peak cooling and electrolysis capacity of 90Watts and is most efficient operating in air temperatures of 0 to 40 Degrees Celsius.

ItemPlantEndothermic_Genepool2.Title: Цветок Зимы (Бета-штамм)
ItemPlantEndothermic_Genepool2.Description: Agrizero's Winterspawn atmospheric bio-processor is a recent addition to their catalog of genespliced environmental decorations. Using ambient heat to split Вода into Летучие вещества and Кислород, the Winterspawn cools its surroundings when supplied with sufficient Азот. The beta variant has a peak cooling and electrolysis capacity of 150Watts and is most efficient operating in air temperatures of 14 to 24 Degrees Celsius.

StructureCentrifuge.Title: Центрифуга
StructureCentrifuge.Description: If a Утилизатор or unbalanced Печь outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore. It also refines Руда (Необработанная) produced from the Глубинный рудокоп and Руда (Космическая) produced from the Ракетный бур. Its bigger brother Газотопливная центрифуга can be used to process items significantly faster. Items processed by the centrifuge will be de-gassed. If openned while powered on, the centrifuge will enter an errored state and reduce its rpm to 0 and then export any items.

StructureElectrolyzer.Title: Электролизёр
StructureElectrolyzer.Description: The Norsec-designed Electrolyzer splits Вода into hydrogen and Кислород. Employing unknown proprietary technology, the device uses water's latent heat as the energy to drive the electrosis process. If there is a downside to this near-miraculous fission, it's that the device is limited by the quantity of power available, which is used to maintain the temperature output. In other words, the machine works best with hot gas.

EVAPage.Title: EVA Suits
EVAPage.Description: Your spacesuit provides you with a portable atmosphere, with adjustable pressure and air conditioning (temperature) settings, as well as an warning system that will alert you should the atmosphere inside the suit become hazardous. It functions in conjunction with a suitable helmet to function properly, as well as suitable gas canisters and filters in the suit's various slots. These will need to be changed regularly, and can also be recharged (or drained) using a Стойка для скафандра. There are several suits, including the Скафандр and the more pressure- and temperature-resistant Прочный скафандр. Your suit various readouts are at the bottom-right of the screen. Pressing the appropriate numeric key (2will bring up a panel showing its slots and settings. These include: - A/C On / Off (i.e. Temperature control on/off) - Filters On / Off - Air On / Off - Pressure Up / Down (with a range of 0kPA to 202kPa, or 0-2 Earth atmospheres) - Temperature Up / Down (with a range of 0°C to 60°C) Suits contains 6-8 slots: - Air tank (x1) - insert a canister or smart canister containing a breathable gas mix, eg Кислород or Азот/Кислород 35/65. - Waste tank (x1) - collects gases removed by the filters - Life support (x1) - holds one battery, which powers your A/C, lights, etc. - Фильтр (x3) - requires at least one Фильтр (Углекислый газ) (if human), depending on your breathable gas mix. Note that a Прочный скафандр has 4 filter slots. - IC - Прочный скафандр only. Pressure: should be set to 50-100 KPa (0.5 to 1 Earth atmospheres). Humans in-game tolerate up to ~250kPa and can survive up to ~300kPA. Temperature: normally set to 18-21°C, with humans in-game preferring 10-29°C, tolerating 0-39°C and surviving around up to 49°C. In higher temperatures, your A/C will consume more battery power to maintain internal temperature. Filters: the default filter is the Углекислый газ filter, which captures the gas generated by humans when breathing out. If you are not using 100% Кислород in your breathing gas, add additional filters, eg if you mix 25% Кислород + 75% Азот, the nitrogen will accumulate in your suit over time and suffocate you, unless you have a nitrogen filter. If you have the correct filters and breathable gas, but are still experiencing problems, use the 'Flush' function on your Space Helmet. Low/critical oxygen warnings will sound as your filters cease to function. If damaged, your suit can be patched by holding duct tape in your hand and using 'activate' button.
